This Rmd ports the unified condition-level DEG + interaction-scoring workflow developed in SIG26 to the SIG18 dataset.

SIG18 differs from SIG26 in its reference state: ligand1 is the Th-polarizing condition with baseline Th0 (activated but unpolarized), while ligand2 is TNF with baseline none. The fully-untreated reference is therefore Th0_none. We encode this by treating Th0 as the baseline for ligand1, so the derived condition variable behaves exactly like SIG26’s: Th0_none -> none, a single polarizing ligand -> its own name (e.g. Th1), Th0_TNF -> TNF, and a polarized + TNF well -> the combination (e.g. Th1-TNF).

# Reference (baseline) value of each ligand. A sample is "untreated" for a
# ligand when that ligand equals its baseline.
baseline1 <- "Th0"    # ligand1 (Th polarization) baseline
baseline2 <- "none"   # ligand2 (TNF) baseline

Mouse 4 and mouse 9 are dropped: they were both on the very edge of the plate and clustered together anomalously across analyses.

metadata <- metadata %>%
  filter(!replicate %in% c("mouse4", "mouse9")) %>%
  filter(sample_ID != "TGFb_none_mouse3_F_E06_col7_SIG18")
# Derive a single `condition` factor from the two ligand columns:
#   - both ligands at baseline -> "none"  (Th0_none, the untreated reference)
#   - one ligand active        -> that ligand's name (single-ligand condition)
#   - both ligands active       -> "ligand1-ligand2" (combination)
make_condition <- function(l1, l2) {
  parts <- c(if (l1 != baseline1) l1, if (l2 != baseline2) l2)
  if (length(parts) == 0) "none" else paste(parts, collapse = "-")
}

metaDF <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    condition = map2_chr(ligand1, ligand2, make_condition),
    replicate = factor(replicate),
    sex       = factor(sex),
    ligand1   = factor(ligand1, levels = c(baseline1, sort(setdiff(unique(ligand1), baseline1)))),
    ligand2   = factor(ligand2, levels = c(baseline2, sort(setdiff(unique(ligand2), baseline2)))),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("none", sort(setdiff(unique(condition), "none"))))
  ) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, c("none","TNF",
                                         "Th1","Th1-TNF",
                                         "Th2","Th2-TNF",
                                         "Th17","Th17-TNF",
                                         "iTreg","iTreg-TNF",
                                         "TGFb","TGFb-TNF"))) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(metaDF) <- metaDF$sample_ID

counts <- counts[, rownames(metaDF)]

Helper Functions

# Build DDS object with counts filtering
build_dds <- function(counts_mat, meta, design, min_count = 10, min_samples = 3) {
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts_mat, colData = meta, design = design)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= min_count) >= min_samples, ]
  DESeq(dds, parallel = TRUE)
}

# Extract DEG results for a vector of coefficient names and combine into one tibble
extract_deg_results <- function(dds, terms, label_col = "term", clean_fn = identity) {
  map_dfr(terms, function(term) {
    results(dds, name = term,
            independentFiltering = FALSE, filterFun = ihw, parallel = TRUE) %>%
      as_tibble(rownames = "ensembl_ID") %>%
      left_join(featureNames, by = "ensembl_ID") %>%
      mutate(!!label_col := clean_fn(term)) %>%
      arrange(padj)
  })
}

# Look up the exact resultsNames() term for a condition value.
# Handles DESeq2 encoding hyphens as either "-" or "." in model matrix names.
cond_term <- function(res_names, cond) {
  pat  <- paste0("^condition_", gsub("-", "[-.]", cond, fixed = FALSE), "_vs_none$")
  hits <- res_names[grepl(pat, res_names)]
  if (length(hits) != 1) stop("Expected 1 match for '", cond, "', found: ", length(hits))
  hits
}

QC Plots

# Condition-level model on all samples; reused for both QC and all DEG analyses below
dds_cond <- build_dds(counts, metaDF, ~ condition + replicate)
vsd      <- vst(dds_cond, blind = TRUE)

Sample Distance Heatmap

sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(vsd)))
distMatrix  <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
rownames(distMatrix) <- colnames(dds_cond)
colnames(distMatrix) <- colnames(dds_cond)

ann_df <- as.data.frame(colData(vsd)[, c("ligand1", "ligand2", "sex")])
mk_pal <- function(n) colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(n)
ann_colors <- list(
  ligand1 = setNames(mk_pal(length(unique(ann_df$ligand1))), sort(unique(ann_df$ligand1))),
  ligand2 = setNames(mk_pal(length(unique(ann_df$ligand2))), sort(unique(ann_df$ligand2))),

)

pheatmap(distMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows = sampleDists,

Per-Replicate Distance Heatmaps

for (rep in levels(metaDF$replicate)) {
  keep    <- colnames(vsd)[colData(vsd)$replicate == rep]
  vsd_rep <- vsd[, keep]

  dists_rep  <- dist(t(assay(vsd_rep)))
  mat_rep    <- as.matrix(dists_rep)
  rownames(mat_rep) <- colnames(vsd_rep)
  colnames(mat_rep) <- colnames(vsd_rep)

  ann_rep <- as.data.frame(colData(vsd_rep)[, c("ligand1", "ligand2")])
  ann_colors_rep <- list(
    ligand1 = setNames(mk_pal(length(unique(ann_rep$ligand1))), sort(unique(ann_rep$ligand1))),
    ligand2 = setNames(mk_pal(length(unique(ann_rep$ligand2))), sort(unique(ann_rep$ligand2)))
  )

  pheatmap(mat_rep,
           clustering_distance_rows = dists_rep,
           clustering_distance_cols = dists_rep,
           col = viridisLite::viridis(100),
           annotation_row = ann_rep,
           annotation_colors = ann_colors_rep,
           show_rownames = FALSE,
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           main = paste("Replicate:", rep))
}

Analysis 1: Condition Effects

Effect of every condition vs. none (Th0_none), using the condition-level model. Captures both single-ligand and combination conditions in a single unified analysis.

cond_terms <- grep("^condition_", resultsNames(dds_cond), value = TRUE)

res_conditions <- extract_deg_results(
  dds_cond, cond_terms,
  label_col = "condition",
  # DESeq2 may encode hyphens as dots in term names; restore hyphens for readability
  clean_fn  = function(x) gsub("\\.", "-", gsub("^condition_|_vs_none$", "", x))
)
write_csv(res_conditions, "../../analysis_outs/deg_updated/res_conditions_SIG18.csv")
res_conditions %>%
  filter(padj < 0.01) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n_degs = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = n_degs)) +
    geom_col() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

Analysis 2: Interaction Scoring

For each gene in each combination condition, quantifies whether the combined response is greater than (synergy), less than (buffering), or equal to (additive) the sum of the individual responses.

Definitions (following SIG18 scoring):

All LFC values are pulled directly from DESeq2 model.

  • lfc_lig1: logFC of ligand1 alone vs. none (Th polarization vs. Th0)
  • lfc_lig2: logFC of ligand2 alone vs. none (TNF vs. none, on Th0 background)
  • lfc_interaction: lfc_combo − lfc_lig1 − lfc_lig2 (deviation from additivity)
  • lfc_total: lfc_lig1 + lfc_lig2 + lfc_interaction = lfc_combo
  • interaction_score: lfc_interaction / lfc_total — fraction of total effect attributable to non-additivity (set to 0 when padj_interaction > 0.1)
  • padj_interaction: adjusted p-value from the synergy contrast lfc_combo − lfc_lig1 − lfc_lig2

Classification: - synergy positive: interaction significant, total effect positive, score > 0 - synergy negative: interaction significant, total effect negative, score > 0 - buffering: interaction significant, score < 0 - none: interaction not significant

Note: ligand1/ligand2 assignment is arbitrary; scores and classes are symmetric with respect to swapping the two ligands.

# Define combo conditions and respective ligands (both ligands active,
# i.e. a polarized Th condition combined with TNF)
combo_map <- metaDF %>%
  filter(as.character(ligand1) != baseline1, as.character(ligand2) != baseline2) %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, ligand1, ligand2) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  distinct()

combo_map

Synergy contrast p-values

Here we are calculating interaction effects using a contrast design. e.g. Th1-TNF_vs_none - (Th1_vs_none + TNF_vs_none)

rn_cond <- resultsNames(dds_cond)

res_synergy_pvals <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(combo_map)), function(i) {
  row <- combo_map[i, ]
  results(dds_cond,
          contrast = list(
            c(cond_term(rn_cond, row$condition)),
            c(cond_term(rn_cond, row$ligand1), cond_term(rn_cond, row$ligand2))
          ),
          independentFiltering = FALSE, filterFun = ihw, parallel = TRUE) %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = "ensembl_ID") %>%
    dplyr::select(ensembl_ID, lfc_interaction = log2FoldChange, padj_interaction = padj) %>%
    mutate(condition = row$condition)
})

Compute interaction scores

lfc_lookup <- res_conditions %>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_ID, gene, condition, log2FoldChange) %>%
  dplyr::rename(lfc = log2FoldChange)

interaction_raw <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(combo_map)), function(i) {
  row <- combo_map[i, ]
  lfc_lookup %>%
    filter(condition == row$condition) %>%
    dplyr::select(ensembl_ID, gene, lfc_combo = lfc) %>%
    left_join(
      lfc_lookup %>% filter(condition == row$ligand1) %>%
        dplyr::select(ensembl_ID, lfc_lig1 = lfc),
      by = "ensembl_ID"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      lfc_lookup %>% filter(condition == row$ligand2) %>%
        dplyr::select(ensembl_ID, lfc_lig2 = lfc),
      by = "ensembl_ID"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      res_synergy_pvals %>% filter(condition == row$condition) %>%
        dplyr::select(ensembl_ID, lfc_interaction, padj_interaction),
      by = "ensembl_ID"
    ) %>%
    mutate(condition = row$condition, ligand1 = row$ligand1, ligand2 = row$ligand2)
})

Classify interaction effects

interaction_scored <- interaction_raw %>%
  mutate(
    lfc_total       = lfc_combo,
    interaction_score = case_when(
      is.na(padj_interaction) | padj_interaction > 0.1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ lfc_interaction / lfc_total
    ),
    interaction_class = case_when(
      padj_interaction <= 0.1 & lfc_total > 0 & interaction_score > 0 ~ "synergy positive",
      padj_interaction <= 0.1 & lfc_total < 0 & interaction_score > 0 ~ "synergy negative",
      padj_interaction <= 0.1 & interaction_score < 0                  ~ "buffering",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    )
  )
interaction_scored %>%
  filter(interaction_class != "none") %>%
  group_by(condition, interaction_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(condition, interaction_class)
write_csv(interaction_scored, "../../analysis_outs/deg_updated/res_interaction_scored_SIG18.csv")
